errors.text_span: индустрия (червено - 61%, строителство - оранжево - 33%, търговия - синьо - 21% и други услуги - зелено - 12%)
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly assigns colors to sectors. In the image, industry is yellow, construction is blue, trade is red, and other services are brown.
The description states construction is 33%, but the image shows construction as 8% in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart.
The description states trade is 21%, but the image shows trade as 19% in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart.
The description states other services are 12%, but the image shows other services as 12% in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart, but the color mapping is incorrect.
The description states construction employment is 33.6 million, but the image shows it as 13.4 million.
The description states trade employment is 9.3 million, but the image shows it as 29.5 million.
The description states other services employment is 19%, but the image shows it as 21%.
The description states industry turnover is 61%, but the image shows it as 31%.
The description states construction turnover is 33.6 million, but the image shows it as 1.9 trillion.
The description states trade turnover is 10.4 million, but the image shows it as 9.9 trillion.
The description states other services turnover is 9.9 million, but the image shows it as 10.6 trillion.
The machine description does not explicitly state that the charts represent the distribution of enterprises, employment, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021.
The machine description does not mention the inclusion of absolute values alongside percentages in the charts.
The machine description does not mention the legend at the bottom of the image that identifies the colors corresponding to each sector.
The machine description does not mention that the sectors are not visually ordered by size in the pie charts.
